description_summary: Use when executing a TypeScript starter plan, resuming with --continue or --from, and verifying tasks/phases with package checks and tests.
should_trigger: Execute the tasks in this existing implementation plan.
Resume the in-progress plan from its remaining checkboxes.
Continue authorized plan phases with verification after each task.
Start work from task P2-T3 in the saved plan.
Read the scratchpad before implementing the next planned change.
should_trigger_test: Record a blocker after three failed attempts instead of retrying blindly.
Finish the current plan scope without starting an unrelated review workflow.
should_not_trigger: Create an implementation plan for a feature spanning API, database and clients.
Walk me through the reasoning behind this existing implementation plan.
Review this branch diff for correctness and starter architecture issues.
Record this reviewed exact package artifact in dependency-vet.json.
Freeze edits to the database package for this investigation.
